title: The Road In
summary: Scene 1. The letter arrives, then each character's first moment on screen: how they look, how we first see them, and a small problem on the way into Kurose, rolled and told by the player.
goal: Each player has said how their character looks and how we first see them, then rolled for and told one small problem on the way into Kurose.
howToPlay: A montage, one player at a time. They tell it; you ask the questions and note the answers. **Nobody meets anybody yet.**

intro.where: Six separate mornings, in six separate places, all in the same week.
intro.readAloud: It happened on six separate mornings, in six separate places, all in the same week. Whatever you were doing that day, you stopped, because an envelope had come for you from a city you had never had a reason to visit.

position.note: Off the map: six homes the players invent.

beats.text: Read the letter aloud, then press Show the table. <trig id="give-enrolment"/> Each player gets a private copy with their own character's name typed in.
beats.readAloud:
Dear Candidate,

Your application to Tokubetsu Taisaku Honbu has been reviewed and accepted. You are asked to report to the combined campus no later than Monday next, where you will be issued instructions, quartered, and enrolled.

Please bring nothing you cannot carry, and nothing you cannot leave.

We look forward to your service.
beats.note:
Plant: The stamp, the typed name and the return slip are for whoever reads closely. Say nothing about them.
If asked what "nothing you cannot leave" means: Pack light. This is enlistment, and the Directorate provides what is needed.

beats.text: Ask each player in turn: How does your character look? How do we first see them? What small thing went wrong on the way in?
beats.direction: One question at a time; a single line is a complete answer. Small means small: a missed tram, a torn strap, a dog. Nothing dangerous, and everyone arrives.
beats.note:
If stuck: Ask: "Where are you, and what are you doing with your hands?"
If they want a journey: A motorbike that shouldn't still run, the early commuter train, the causeway on foot, a fishing boat.
If someone arrives undisguised: That is the player's call. People stare; plenty of aliens in Kurose refuse to wear a glamour.

beats.text: Ask which skill they use to get past it. Post the check (any skill, DC 15), then they tell us how it goes.
beats.direction: Take any skill they can argue for. Give them the result, then hand it back: "Tell us how it goes."
beats.note: If they would rather not roll: They just tell it. No result costs anything, and everyone reaches Kurose by Monday.

beats.text: When an arrival ends where people stand and wait, describe a small deep-violet mark at head height on the wall. Then offer the check.
beats.note:
Plant: On a wall a waiting crowd faces, in every arrival it fits. The same violet, at the same height, every time.
If no arrival fits: Put it at the end of one random player's spotlight anyway.
Secret: The marks are Cicada's, laid on walls where crowds wait, as places to show a crowd something one day. Nothing this week explains them.

handouts.title: The acceptance letter
handouts.body:
特別対策本部SPECIAL COUNTERMEASURES HEADQUARTERSKurose
Form No.1-A

CANDIDATE INTAKEDate as postmark.

NOTICE OF ACCEPTANCE

Dear ,

Your application to Tokubetsu Taisaku Honbu has been reviewed and accepted.

You are asked to report to the combined campus no later than the first Monday of term, where you will be issued instructions, quartered, and enrolled.

Monday next繰上BROUGHT FORWARD

Please bring nothing you cannot carry, and nothing you cannot leave.

We look forward to your service.

Deputy Directorfor Tokubetsu Taisaku Honbu

NOTES FOR CANDIDATES

  1. On arrival, report to the Candidate Gate on the landward side of the causeway, and show this letter.
  2. Travel is at the candidate's expense.
  3. Uniform, bedding and personal equipment are issued on enrolment.
  4. A medical examination forms part of enrolment. No preparation is required.
  5. Service with Tokubetsu Taisaku Honbu is separate from national service, and does not discharge any obligation owed to Minkai's own army or navy.

RETURN SLIPComplete in block capitals. Hand in at the Candidate Gate.

Full name
Date of birth
Mother's maiden name
Signature of candidate
handouts.gmNotes: Secret: this year's intake was brought forward two weeks because the pilot expected to fly first refused the draft. Nothing today explains the stamp.
catchables: The red BROUGHT FORWARD stamp, with "Monday next" in pen: every candidate's letter has one this year, and nobody says why.
The typed name, with a lower-case e that strikes low: the admissions typewriter. Their Form 12-B on Monday comes off the same machine.
The signature: the Deputy Director's, printed. Nobody can read it.
Mother's maiden name on the return slip: Form 12-B asks for it twice more on Monday.
Travel at the candidate's expense: why each of them came the cheapest way they could.
"Separate from national service": Minkai's army and navy resent a foreign base in their harbour.
The medical, with "No preparation is required": it is the first thing on Monday.

outro.endsWhen: All six arrivals are told. Stop before anyone meets.

transition.line: Skip to Monday morning, in the queue at the Candidate Gate.

departure.question: How do you arrive in Kurose?

destinations.label: By train
destinations.blurb: Into Mainland Platforms, where the ordinary passenger trains stop.

destinations.label: By ferry
destinations.blurb: To the ferry stages at the Old Landing, the city's oldest waterfront.

destinations.label: By bus
destinations.blurb: From the Southern Reach, the last stop on the line.

destinations.label: By the coast road
destinations.blurb: In from the North Shore Town, on the one road that joins it to the city.

destinations.label: By tram
destinations.blurb: Down from the Upper Wards, on the line they share with the city.

destinations.label: By bicycle
destinations.blurb: Through the Flats, where there are more bicycles than road.

destinations.label: On foot
destinations.blurb: In from the Far Quarter, the long way round.

destinations.label: By teleportation
destinations.blurb: One moment you weren't here. However it happened, you're stood at the Landing End now, same as anyone who walked.

then.question: Report to the Candidate Gate by Monday.

outro.onwards: Intake Medicals, which opens in the queue at the Candidate Gate.
writeDown: For each player: look, first shot, problem, skill, result, and one line of how it went.
How often the violet mark came up, and who rolled well on it.

position.note: All six head for the Candidate Gate, separately, to arrive by Monday.

temptations.text: If an opening is landing thin, ask: what did you leave behind to answer this letter?

reactionPrompts.text: The six openings keeping an even pace.
reactionPrompts.scaleNote: 0 = one or two spotlights ate the scene, 10 = even all the way round.

reactionPrompts.text: Players telling their own small problems.
reactionPrompts.scaleNote: 0 = every player handed it back to the GM, 10 = every player told their own.

reactionPrompts.text: The violet mark noticed as a repeating detail.
reactionPrompts.scaleNote: 0 = nobody registered it, 10 = the table is already asking about it.

notes: No cast, no landmark and no strategy-layer track, all on purpose: six separate places with nothing shared to orbit, and nothing on the board exists yet. Every check here is free on every result, so nobody's first roll with their own character can hurt them.
